method: Each of the four getters executed natively in Unicorn on the memory image with random object bytes; vtable slots 0x40/0x48/0x60/0x68 of 0x29ca8a0 statically checked to point at them; rax, rsp, rip and all fixture bytes compared to the Python accessors
comparisons: object, header, added-row and removed-row bytes unchanged after each call
row decode against the bytes written to the fixture
coverage: added header inline in the object (+0xd8/+0xe8) and on the heap
removed counts with the high bit set (u32 zero-extended)
random bytes in all other object fields
limits: Leaf getters only; the producers that fill the lists (0x199b590 and the broadphase update) are not executed.
Row meaning (body, body, key) comes from consumer reads, decode is authored.
No live validation; the vtable identification is static.
